warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 60 to 70 km/h with peak gusts of around 90 km/h are possible in the higher elevations of the northeast ranges during this morning ahead of an approaching trough. Winds are expected to ease below threshold later this morning. Locations which may be affected include Falls Creek and Mt Hotham. 93 km/h wind gust recorded at Mount Hotham AWS at 4:53am AEST.
